name: Find frequency peak of PSD data
summary: Finds the peak frequency of each channel's power spectral density within a chosen frequency band with MNE-Python and outputs a TSV of peaks and summary plots.
description: Reads a PSD table (channels by frequencies), restricts it to frequencies between fmin and fmax, and finds the main spectral peak per channel with mne.preprocessing.peak_finder. Use it, for example, to estimate individual alpha peak frequency from MEG/EEG PSDs. It needs a PSD .tsv with a 'channels' column, such as produced by brainlife PSD Apps.

inputs.description: Power spectral density table (.tsv) with one row per channel and one column per frequency.
inputs.requirements: Must have a 'channels' column; frequency column names must be numeric.

outputs.description: psd.tsv with the peak frequency of each channel.
Histogram of peak frequencies across channels and per-channel PSD plots with the detected peaks.

citations.text: Hayashi S, Caron BA, et al. brainlife.io: A decentralized and open source cloud platform to support neuroscience research. arXiv (2023).
